verdict.rationale: React's documented capabilities directly target large-app maintainability and performance. Encapsulated, composable components and TypeScript support aid maintainability, and the eslint-plugin-react-hooks rules catch severe bugs early. React Compiler optimizes builds automatically, removes manual memoization and can be adopted incrementally, while React DevTools help find performance problems; community commentary notes React's aggressive scheduling of DOM updates. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of performance and maintainability holding up as team and codebase size grow, and independent or hands-on corroboration of large-codebase outcomes or React Compiler results.
